brief: A clean, modern wordmark for a community site for Akai MPC software users. It should feel like a music-tech brand: refined and confident, with one clever detail instead of retro or blocky styling, and work as a 16 px favicon.
criteria: Success: reads instantly as runmpc, carries one ownable idea, holds at 16 px, works in one colour and reversed, avoids the Run-D.M.C. block look.

concepts.name: Sine
concepts.idea: The 'un' in run is one continuous sine wave: the name carries a sound wave.
rationale: One ownable detail inside a clean lowercase wordmark
The wave stands alone as favicon, app icon and avatar
Built from circles and straight stems only, monoline, with optical overshoot

recommendation: Sine: final artwork, variants, web icon set and usage guide delivered.
next_steps: Roll out favicon and header on the site
Optional: extend the wave into dividers, loaders and motion
